text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate across prod-us-east. Threshold breached (5m average) — 12% 5xx, p95 latency spike. Paging ajay (on-call).
ajay: on it, taking page. starting triage. pinging maria for loadbalancer/infra details.
maria: I saw alert — dashboards show error spikes at 14:02 UTC. Envoy 1.22 config push from config-service at 13:58 by lucas. forwarding config diff: https://internal/redwood/configs/changes/1802345600
lucas: that change rolled a new route config and updated retry policy (retries: 3, per_try_timeout: 2s) and circuit_breakers with low max_connections. I can roll back if we confirm it's the trigger.
ajay: show me the relevant snippet pls
lucas: ```yaml
virtual_hosts:
  - name: api
    routes:
      - match: /v1/
        route:
          cluster: api-cluster
          retry_policy:
            retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused-stream
            num_retries: 3
            per_try_timeout: 2s
    typed_per_filter_config:
      envoy.filters.network.circuit_breaker:
        thresholds:
          - max_connections: 200
``` 
zoe: from metrics: backend pods started returning 502/504 after the config roll — visible increase in queued connections and connection resets. looks like retry amplification hitting overloaded backends.
ajay: possibility: retries + low max_connections caused envoy to spill requests and flip to 5xx. Need to reduce retries or raise cb limits. Can we quickly disable retries at the gateway for /v1/* as mitigation?
maria: yes, we can push a targeted override to set num_retries: 0 for that route. preparing a quick patch, will push canary to one envoy cluster first.
lucas: also note the route weight change included a small traffic shift to a new region which had fewer nodes — that plus retries may have concentrated traffic.
ajay: plan: 1) disable retries on edge route 2) increase circuit_breaker max_connections for api-cluster to 1000 3) rollback the route weight shift if still elevated. We'll do 1 then 2, monitor 3.
oncall-bot: @channel incident acknowledged. Severity: Sev2. Current assignees: ajay (primary), maria (infra), lucas (config). Paging customer-success for impact.
customer-success: seeing customer reports of timeouts for a few high-throughput customers. Notified top-10 teams and set expectation: engineers are mitigating — more updates in 10m.
ajay: maria, deploy patch to disable retries (canary) now. I want metrics window open: grafana/dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/edge/latency
maria: pushing patch to canary cluster now. CLI:
```
kubectl apply -f disable-retries-canary.yaml --context=prod-edge-canary
``` 
maria: canary applied at 14:12 UTC. watching.
lucas: logs from envoy-canary show retry header still present on some requests from legacy clients, but server side honors new config. p50 latency improving slightly.
zoe: backend queue depth dropping on canary path. 5xx rate on canary decreased to 1.2% (was 11%). good sign.
ajay: proceed to global rollout of retries disabled. maria, coordinate.
maria: starting rollout to remaining edge clusters with 30s stagger.
maria: global rollout completed at 14:18 UTC.
ajay: increasing cb thresholds for api-cluster. maria, execute the change.
maria: applying cb increase:
```
kubectl patch secret envoy-cb-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"api-cluster-max-conns":"1000"}}'
``` 
maria: pushed, Envoys picked up config at 14:21 UTC.
lucas: monitoring shows backend error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% over 10m. p95 latency dropping as well.
ajay: good. now evaluate if we need to rollback route weight shift.
zoe: route weight still shifted 10% to new region. that region has autoscaler misconfig (min replicas low). I'd recommend rollback to previous weights until autoscaler fix.
ajay: rollback route weight now.
lucas: rolling back weights to previous: ```bash
apply-route-weights --route api --weights 'us-east: 90, new-region: 10' -> 'us-east: 100, new-region: 0'
``` 
lucas: rollback completed at 14:34 UTC.
zoe: after rollback, error rate stable at 1.1% and p95 latency back to baseline. No further customer complaints in last 10m.
customer-success: confirmed top customers seeing normal traffic. closing active customer notifications; will send follow-up with RCA.
ajay: summary of mitigation: disabled retries on edge route, increased circuit_breaker max_connections, rolled back route weight. All applied by 14:34 UTC. Incident moving to monitoring state.
oncall-bot: auto-checklist: create postmortem doc, include config diffs, who deployed, timeline. assigning to lucas and zoe for RCA.
lucas: I'll draft config diffs and timeline. quick note: we need safe defaults: limit retry_on to idempotent ops and implement a global retry budget to avoid amplification.
zoe: also add test for route weight/region autoscaler interplay in infra runbook.
ajay: action items: lucas - postmortem draft, zoe - infra autoscaler runbook updates, maria - add canary automation to test retry policy changes; all due EOD tomorrow. I'll prepare external status blurb for customers.
customer-success: thanks. will wait for the RCA before drafting customer-facing summary.
ajay: closing incident thread in 30m if stable. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: degraded -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to Sev3 at 14:45 UTC.
maria: leaving logs and config snapshots in runbook: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1802345678/runbook
lucas: +1 on follow-ups. will add link to commit that introduced change.
ajay: final note: no DB changes, this was infra/proxy config induced. marking primary root cause: Envoy retry policy + low circuit breaker max_connections + traffic shift created retry amplification leading to backend overload and 5xx surge. postmortem owners assigned.
